title: 第二十二章 师兄第二十三章 这世上没有无解的难题
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
周青梅的话喊得还是晚了一步。
那人剑法极其凌厉，逼迫的那黑衣人左支右拙，最终空门大开，被他一剑刺入心门，直接死在当场。
周青梅赶过去的时候，那人正收剑入鞘，看到周青梅还咧嘴一笑
“周师妹，好久不见。”
周青梅没去看他，而是蹲下身来检查这黑衣人的情况。
确定此人身死之后，这才无奈的叹了口气
“张师兄，都说了让你手下留情，你怎么还是把他给杀了啊？”
“啊？这一淫贼，你留着他作甚？”
那张师兄不明所以。
周青梅有心解释，一时之间却又不知道该从何处说起。
只能无奈的问道
“你怎么会在这里？”
“听说周师妹有难，师兄自然不能袖手旁观，此番下山便是为了帮师妹排忧解难的。”
那张师兄笑着说道
“师妹，你招惹了什么麻烦？说来听听，师兄给你出头。”
“我招惹了黑煞教。”
“哈哈哈，我道如何，不过区区黑煞教，师兄我……啥？”
自信满满的声音，忽然戛然而止，那张师兄瞠目结舌
“你说的是三十年前那个黑煞教？
“不是，他们三十年前不就被灭了吗？什么时候又冒出来的？”

周青梅有些不耐烦解释。
方家这边本来就是一条线索，今天晚上正好赶上了，本以为可以拿下这黑衣人，结果这张师兄好死不死的也在这个时候抵达。
还先一步杀了这黑衣人，让这条线索无疾而终。
如今心情正不好呢，实在是没有耐心给他从头说起。
来到方书文身边，方书文抬头看了她一眼，让她借夜色看看怀里的姑娘
“这就是方家大小姐？”
“没错。”
周青梅点了点头
“她怎么样了？”
“应该是中了迷药，并无大碍，药效过了之后，也就清醒了。”
“那就好。”
那张师兄此时也凑了上来，看看方书文，又看了看周青梅
“周师妹，这位兄台是？”
“在下方书文。”
方书文看了周青梅一眼
“目前受雇保护周大小姐。”
“受雇……”
张师兄有些诧异的看了周青梅一眼。
周青梅说道
content_en:
Zhou Qingmei's words were still a step too late.
The man's swordsmanship was extremely powerful, and he forced the man in black to hold back. In the end, the door was wide open, and his sword pierced his heart, killing him on the spot.
When Zhou Qingmei rushed over, the man was sheathing his sword and grinned when he saw Zhou Qingmei.
"Junior sister Zhou, long time no see."
Zhou Qingmei did not look at him, but squatted down to check the condition of the man in black.
After confirming that this person was dead, he sighed helplessly.
"Senior Brother Zhang, I told you to show mercy, why did you still kill him?"
"Ah? What are you keeping this thief for?"
That senior brother Zhang didn't know why.
Zhou Qingmei wanted to explain, but for a moment she didn't know where to start.
I can only ask helplessly
"Why are you here?"
"I heard that Junior Sister Zhou is in trouble, so Senior Brother can't just sit back and watch. The reason for coming down the mountain is to help Junior Sister solve her problems."
Senior Brother Zhang said with a smile
"Junior sister, what kind of trouble have you caused? Tell me, senior brother will help you."
"I provoked the Black Evil Cult."
"Hahaha, what do I think? It's just the Black Evil Sect, senior brother, I...what?"
The confident voice suddenly stopped, and Senior Brother Zhang was dumbfounded.
"Are you talking about the Black Evil Cult from thirty years ago?
"No, weren't they destroyed thirty years ago? When did it appear again? "
Zhou Qingmei was a little impatient to explain.
There was originally a clue from the Fang family, and they just happened to catch up tonight. They thought they could capture the man in black, but it turned out that senior brother Zhang, who was still alive, also arrived at this time.
He also killed the man in black first, leaving this clue unsolved.
I'm in a bad mood now, and I really don't have the patience to start over from the beginning.
Arriving next to Fang Shuwen, Fang Shuwen looked up at her and asked her to take advantage of the night to see the girl in her arms.
"Is this the eldest lady of the Fang family? "
"That's right. "
Zhou Qingmei nodded
"How is she? "
"It's probably because he was drugged, and it was nothing serious. After the drug took effect, he woke up. "
"That's good. "
Senior Brother Zhang also came up at this time and looked at Fang Shuwen and then at Zhou Qingmei.
"Junior sister Zhou, who is this brother? "
"Written below. "
Fang Shuwen glanced at Zhou Qingmei
"Currently employed to protect Miss Zhou. "
"Employed..."
Senior Brother Zhang glanced at Zhou Qingmei in surprise.
